'''Pendaxa''' was a celestial body<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Pendaxa system/Legends|Pendaxa system]], a part of the [[Jjannex sector/Legends|Jjannex sector]]<ref name="EAOC Pendaxa" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion<ref name="WesternReaches" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Pendaxa" /> It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Lipsec Run/Legends|Lipsec Run]],<ref name="Lipsec" /> which linked it to the [[Kelrodo-Ai system/Legends|Kelrodo-Ai system]]<ref name="EGTW" /> of the [[Steniplis sector/Legends|Steniplis sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector's]] [[Mev system/Legends|Mev system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The [[Eighteenth Army|Eighteenth Sector Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in Pendaxa's vicinity during the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Pendaxa fell within the territory controlled by the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]], and that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] fought a famous [[Battle of Pendaxa|battle]] there as part of the [[Western Reaches Operation]], a campaign targeting [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and Separatist remnants that was a part of the Imperial [[Reconquest of the Rim]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pendaxa was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the Pendaxa [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Pendaxa, in grid square K-19.<ref name="EAOC Pendaxa" />
